name: @harperfast/fulltext
description: Native Tantivy full-text indexing for Node.js

scripts.build: npm run build:typescript && npm run build:native
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:typescript && napi build --platform --no-js --dts ts/addon.d.ts --features node-api
scripts.clean:typescript: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.benchmark:native: npm run build && node scripts/run-local.mjs benchmarks/native.mjs
scripts.benchmark:multi-index: npm run build && node scripts/run-local.mjs benchmarks/multi-index.mjs
scripts.benchmark:inspect: npm run build && node scripts/run-local.mjs benchmarks/inspect.mjs
scripts.examples:smoke: node scripts/run-local.mjs examples/basic.mjs && node scripts/run-local.mjs examples/query-modes.mjs && node scripts/run-local.mjs examples/checkpoint-recovery.mjs && node scripts/run-local.mjs examples/highlighting.mjs && node scripts/run-local.mjs examples/multi-index.mjs && node scripts/run-local.mjs examples/reset-rebuild.mjs
scripts.benchmark:smoke: node scripts/run-local.mjs benchmarks/native.mjs --smoke --mutation-driver logical && node scripts/run-local.mjs benchmarks/native.mjs --smoke --mutation-driver low-level
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.prepack: npm run build:typescript && npm run verify:package-artifacts
scripts.test:node: npm run build:test-native && npm run build:typescript && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs test && npm run build:native && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs release
scripts.test:optimized-native: npm run build:test-native:release && npm run build:typescript && node scripts/run-node-tests.mjs optimized
